jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Education
jobs.description: CrossFit is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Education. You will own product strategy and execution for CrossFit's Education line of business, including the learner experience, course registration, content authoring and delivery, learning platforms, and credentialing. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role: you are the dedicated product specialist for Education, translating the needs of Education leaders, program owners, instructors, and learners into a clear product vision, roadmap, and priorities. You will partner closely with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Operations, and Education leadership, and coordinate with product owners for adjacent products (for example, the mobile app) to align strategy and sequencing across the broader product surface. Education is central to CrossFit's identity and has significant room to grow. The foundation is an older, layered stack of in-house software and vendor tools. This role requires someone resilient and responsive, strong at strategy, and disciplined about tight feedback loops: a person who can bring structure and clarity to ambiguity, make disciplined trade-offs, and deliver measurable results. Responsibilities Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Education, in alignment with company priorities and business objectives. Establish clear product goals, success metrics, and KPIs, and regularly evaluate performance against expected outcomes. Use customer insights, product analytics, market trends, and business data to identify opportunities and guide product decisions. Balance learner experience, business impact, technical investment, and available resources, and make and communicate clear trade-off decisions when priorities compete. Bring an informed point of view on where online learning is heading, then commit fully to the direction the business chooses. Product Execution: Lead the product lifecycle from discovery and validation through development, launch, adopt

jobs.title: Seminar Staff Candidate Program
jobs.description: There are currently no open positions, but we are accepting applications for future openings. Seminar Staff trainers are hired via a Candidate Program which involves an assessment process. To be considered for the Candidate Program, you must meet the following minimum requirements regardless of location : ● Hold a current CF-L3 credential (see here and here for more information) ● Be an active, and working trainer at a CrossFit affiliate ● Fluent in English Compensation Additional Information CrossFit is a proud equal employment opportunity employer. We seek to recruit, develop, and retain qualified applicants from a variety of backgrounds, skills, and perspectives. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, religion, national origin, age, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, past or present military service, disability, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: AI Trainer - Video Annotation
jobs.description: AI Trainer - Video Annotation Remote | Independent Contractor Prove your skills. Get certified. Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. ▌ What you will do As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to: Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events. Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines. Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements. Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues. ▌ What you bring Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking. Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently. A commitment to accuracy and consistency. No previous AI or robotics experience required. ▌ What the work looks like You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible. Please note: We currently have three projects open, and completing the certification process will allow us to evaluate which project may be the best fit for you.
